IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with dark hair in a loose
updo and sunglasses on her head stands against a
white backdrop. She wears a fitted black
long-sleeve mock-neck crop top with a small logo,
paired with wide brown cargo trousers with
grommet details, large patch pockets, and a black
studded belt. Chunky black platform loafers
complete the look. One arm is raised to her head.
Her expression is calm and direct. Soft, even studio
light. Palette of black, chocolate, and silver
hardware. Sleek and utilitarian, in the style of a
streetwear lookbook.
